review_evidence: BinaryCounter.lean: Defines increment/run with exact cost theorems (increment_value, increment_time, run_value, run_time_eq, run_time_lt, run_time_ge)
BinaryHeap.lean: Defines MinHeap with siftUp/siftDown, proves heap order, permutation, multiset preservation, and exact multiplicity behavior (elements_push, count_push_self, extractMin_elements)
BinomialHeap.lean: Defines BinomialTree/Forest with Valid invariant, proves rank/size/order invariants and meld/insert/extractMin correctness (elements_meldTrees, valid_insert, deleteMin_elements)
DaryHeap.lean: Generalizes binary heap to d-ary with configurable arity, proves darySiftUp/darySiftDown correctness and exact multiset preservation
DoublyLinkedList/Basic.lean: Defines Node/Represents with listPrepend, proves exact pointer-event costs and representation preservation (listPrepend_time, listPrepend_represents)
DoublyLinkedList/Delete.lean: Implements listDelete with exact NIL-test/pointer-assignment costs, proves representation preservation (listDelete_time, listDelete_represents)
DoublyLinkedList/Insert.lean: Implements listInsert with exact costs, proves representation preservation (listInsert_time, listInsert_represents)
EditDistance/Algorithm.lean: Bottom-up DP with deterministic script reconstruction, proves optimality (editDistance_minimal) and exact cost (editDistance_time_spec)
Knapsack.lean: Capacity-indexed DP with Finset result, proves global optimality (solve_correct) and exact pseudo-polynomial cost (solve_time)
LongestCommonSubsequence.lean: Prefix DP with witness reconstruction, proves optimal length and witness correctness (longestCommonSubsequence_correct)

MatrixChain/Correctness.lean: Proves matrixChainOrder returns valid parenthesization with optimal cost (matrixChainOrder_parenthesization_valid, matrixChainOrder_cost_eq, matrixChainOrder_minimal) and exact event counts (matrixChainOrder_candidateEvaluations, matrixChainOrder_reconstructionNodes)
summary: All 132 files in this work unit contain formal mathematical content - definitions, theorems, and proofs about algorithms and data structures. Every file inspected contains Lean formalizations with verified correctness and complexity proofs for data structures (BinaryCounter, BinaryHeap, BinomialHeap, DaryHeap, DoublyLinkedList, HashTable, IndexedMinQueue, OrderStatisticTree, Queue, SkipList, Stack, Trie, UnionFind) and algorithms (Dynamic Programming: EditDistance, Knapsack, LongestCommonSubsequence, MatrixChain, OptimalBST, RodCutting; Graph: Kruskal, Prim, FloydWarshall, ShortestPath, TransitiveClosure; Greedy: Huffman, IntervalScheduling, OfflineCaching; Matrix: Multiply, Strassen; Number Theory: ModularExponentiation; Random: RandomlyPermute; Search: Binary, Linear, LowerBound; Selection: HireAssistant, MinMax, Quickselect; Sorting: Bucket, Counting, Heap, Insertion, Partition, Quick, Radix, Selection; String Matching: BoyerMoore, FiniteAutomaton, KnuthMorrisPratt, Naive, RabinKarp, ZAlgorithm; Quantum: Grover; Computability: CookLevin). None are pure import aggregators, and no file's content is exactly represented by another indexed document.
